entries.title: Add once-off items to purchase orders
entries.description: Add non-stock custom lines for items that are not in the parts catalogue. Receive and reverse arrivals, amend sent lines, and cross-check them against supplier invoices.

entries.title: Control who appears as a quote salesperson
entries.description: Mark users as quote salespeople so only the appropriate people appear in the Salesperson picker. Existing salesperson assignments remain intact.

entries.title: Choose from the current salesperson roster
entries.description: Quote salesperson pickers now show users who are marked as quote salespeople while preserving existing assignments.
